items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: The interviewer states 'you helped him out to get started in the barber', implying a personal connection and assistance, but not a professional musical collaboration.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Yeah. They were all born in past. I'm pretty sure they were. They were an old relative.
Johnny and Sylvester and you. The young one told me that you helped him out to get started in the barber. That's how I knew it must be you when you said you were a barber.
I've done a little bit of everything and nothing much of a knife.
